mapper.select: select setting_value from tb_general_setting where setting_key = #{settingKey} order by id

select substring_index(group_concat(warning_type),',',1) AS warningType, ifnull(count(warning_grade='1' or null),0) AS oneWarningCount, ifnull(count(warning_grade='2' or null),0) AS twoWarningCount, ifnull(count(warning_grade='3' or null),0) AS threeWarningCount from tb_early_warning where is_affirm = '2' and warning_type in ('01','02','03') and principal = #{earlyWarningDto.principalName} and warning_time >= #{earlyWarningDto.startTime} and warning_time <= #{earlyWarningDto.endTime}

SELECT id as id, area_id AS areaId, stack_id AS stackId, is_affirm AS affirm, warning_grade AS warningGrade, node_type AS nodeType, site_route as siteRoute, warning_time AS warningTime FROM tb_early_warning where (id,warning_grade) IN ( SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(id),',',1) id,MAX(warning_grade) AS warning_grade FROM tb_early_warning where warning_type in ('01','02','03') and principal = #{earlyWarningDto.principalName} and warning_time >= #{earlyWarningDto.startTime} and warning_time <= #{earlyWarningDto.endTime} GROUP BY site_route,is_affirm) ORDER BY is_affirm DESC,warning_grade DESC,site_route desc

SELECT id AS id, area_id AS areaId, stack_id AS stackId, is_affirm AS affirm, warning_grade AS warningGrade, warning_type AS warningType, node_type AS nodeType, warning_val AS warningVal, site_route as siteRoute, warning_time AS warningTime FROM tb_early_warning where (id,warning_grade) in ( SELECT substring_index(group_concat(id),',',1) id,MAX(warning_grade) AS warning_grade FROM tb_early_warning where warning_type = #{earlyWarningDto.warningType} and principal = #{earlyWarningDto.principalName} and warning_time >= #{earlyWarningDto.startTime} and warning_time <= #{earlyWarningDto.endTime} GROUP BY is_affirm,site_route) ORDER BY is_affirm DESC,warning_grade DESC,site_route desc
select warning_time from tb_early_warning where is_affirm = #{affirm} and warning_grade = #{warningGrade} and warning_type = #{warningType} and site_route = #{siteRoute} LIMIT 1

SELECT t.id as id, t.site_route as pidRoute, t.node_id as nodeId, t.warning_grade as warningGrade, t.node_type as nodeType, t.warning_type as warningType, t2.site_x as siteX,t2.site_y as siteY,t2.site_z as siteZ FROM tb_early_warning t left JOIN tb_node t2 ON t.node_id =t2.node_id WHERE warning_type IN ('01','02','03') AND is_affirm = #{affirm} and t.site_route = #{siteRoute}

SELECT t.id as id, t.warning_grade as warningGrade, t.site_route as pidRoute, t.node_id as nodeId, t.node_type as nodeType, t.warning_type as warningType,t.warning_val as warningVal, t2.site_x as siteX,t2.site_y as siteY,t2.site_z as siteZ FROM tb_early_warning t left JOIN tb_node t2 ON t.node_id =t2.node_id WHERE warning_type = #{warningType} AND is_affirm = #{affirm} and t.site_route = #{siteRoute}
select count(*) from tb_early_warning where node_id = #{nodeId} and is_affirm = 2 and warning_type = #{warningType}

sysdate(),sysdate(),

sysdate(),sysdate(),

mapper.select: select node_id nodeId, node_type nodeType, warning_val_one warningValOne, warning_time_one warningTimeOne from tb_early_warning where warning_type in ('01','02','03') and is_affirm = 2

SELECT count(1) as sum, ifnull(count(is_affirm = '0' or null),0) as deal,ifnull(count(is_affirm != '0' or null),0) as noDeal,round((ifnull(count(is_affirm = '0' or null),0)/ifnull(count(1),1)),2) as treatmentRate, ${dateType} AS day FROM tb_early_warning WHERE 1=1 and id in #{id} GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
SELECT count(1) as sum,warning_type AS warningType FROM tb_early_warning WHERE 1=1 and id in #{id} GROUP BY warning_type ORDER BY warning_type
select warning_grade as warningGrade, warning_val as warningVal, warning_time as warningTime from tb_early_warning where id in #{id}
mapper.update: update tb_early_warning set is_affirm = 2 where node_id = #{nodeId} and warning_type = #{warningType} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

select (select setting_value from tb_general_setting where setting_key = 'color' and setting_name = 'one') as oneColor, (select setting_value from tb_general_setting where setting_key = 'color' and setting_name = 'two') as twoColor, (select setting_value from tb_general_setting where setting_key = 'color' and setting_name = 'three') as threeColor from tb_general_setting limit 1
